branch: S2 FIRES — the shape-free floor does NOT survive at scale (0.5286 -> 0.2090), retiring the below-floor claim as a task property. S3's apparent failure is a CELL-SIZE effect, not scale: at matched cell size the oracle returns to 0.9459, within 0.0065 of the original.

sample.filters: MP, 2-4 elements, conventional cell <= 80 atoms, stratified by crystal system
sample.quarantine_criterion: flipped OR not neighborhood_stable OR keep_for_training False

full_sample.note: SUPERSEDED — these include 62 structures that should have been quarantined. Retained as data; the clean values in full_sample_CANONICAL_clean are canonical. Largest shift 0.0041.

size_matched_control.purpose: the pre-registration required checking composition before calling anything a scale effect. The 1995 sample has median 38 atoms per cell against the original's 14.

two_causes_separated.oracle: CELL-SIZE effect. 0.9524 (n=210, median 14 atoms) -> 0.9459 (matched, median 17) -> 0.8797 (full, median 38). More atoms means more projective coincidence and correspondence ambiguity. The identifiability result generalises once cell size is held fixed.
two_causes_separated.floor: NOT a cell-size effect. 0.5286 -> 0.2205 (matched) -> 0.2090 (full). The floor stays near 0.22 at both cell-size regimes, so 0.5286 was a property of the ORIGINAL 210 DRAW rather than of the task.

deltas.note: differences of stored values, published so the prose has provenance

claim_retired.claim: all 13 zero-shot models fall below a composition-only baseline
claim_retired.status: RE-SCOPED to the original 210 sample; no longer a task property
claim_retired.thesis_unaffected: the thesis rests on the oracle-to-model gap, which SURVIVES at matched size (0.9459 vs 0.4429), not on the below-floor comparison — which is why the abstract sentence was written to survive the floor moving

mechanism_not_claimed: why the original 3-feature floor was so high is NOT established. What is established is that 0.5286 does not reproduce on an independently drawn, composition-excluded, identically stratified sample at either cell-size regime.
not_run: the tiered MODEL arms on the 500-structure core subset (19,500 calls). Every model number in the package still rests on n=210 and is reported with that sample named.

self_defect.what: published 'quarantine rate 0'; the true rate is 3.11%
self_defect.cause: the quarantine test read a top-level tolerance_robust key that the schema nests under 'tolerance', so .get(...,True) defaulted to True for every structure and the filter never fired. The loop's printed 'quarantined 0' was the count of a filter that could not fire.
self_defect.cost: none to the conclusions — rescoring without the 62 shifts every quantity by at most 0.0041, so S2 still fires. But the pre-registered 10% gate was untested until the audit.
self_defect.lesson: a zero from a gate is only evidence the gate ran. Assert the gate fires on a known-bad case, or read the field path back from the schema before trusting a count of zero.

spglib_warning_audit.test: a silent fallback to the trivial group would show as an excess of P1
spglib_warning_audit.verdict: CLEAN — a normal distribution for a triclinic-inclusive draw, not a degenerate one
